english.title: Drive a vehicle at excess speed on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..), drove a vehicle namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a speed in excess of **(..SPECIFY THE SPEED LIMIT..)

(A)_[on the airport's apron or roads]_
(B)_[indicated by a sign erected in a conspicuous or appropriate position]_
(C)_[indicated by a sign which conformed to the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 1994]_

otherwise than in an emergency
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.1(d) and 2.2 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
